# TicketTreat

> TicketTreat (https://tickettreat.eu) is an event platform for Czechia, mostly Prague: game nights, quizzes, workshops and community evenings run by independent organizers. Guests find events, register in a few taps and keep QR tickets in one place; the QR is scanned at the door.

Key facts:

- Where: Czechia, mostly Prague. Pages are in English and Czech.
- Registration on TicketTreat is free. Guests sign in with email, Google or Telegram; Telegram is optional.
- Payments: during the current pilot TicketTreat does not take card payments. For priced events the organizer sets the price and payment is made directly to the organizer, not through TicketTreat. A QR ticket is issued right after registration.
- Entry: the guest shows the ticket's QR code at the door; each QR works once and only for its event.
- Full events can have a waiting list; joining it does not guarantee a ticket.
- Rewards: guests earn levels for repeat visits to the same organizer. A visit counts only when the QR is scanned at the door. Each organizer sets how many visits each level needs and what it gives; counts start over every quarter.
- Organizers create events, take registrations, check QR tickets at the door and message attendees from one dashboard.
- Contact: contact@tickettreat.eu. Privacy requests: privacy@tickettreat.eu. Telegram bot: https://t.me/TicketTreatBot

## Main pages

- [Upcoming events (English)](https://tickettreat.eu/en): all public events with dates, venues and prices
- [Upcoming events (Czech)](https://tickettreat.eu/cs): the same in Czech
- [Organizers](https://tickettreat.eu/organizers): public profiles of event organizers and their upcoming events
- [FAQ (English)](https://tickettreat.eu/en/faq): registration, QR tickets, payments, cancellations, support
- [FAQ (Czech)](https://tickettreat.eu/cs/faq)
- [For organizers](https://tickettreat.eu/business): how hosting events on TicketTreat works
